summary: Read the nonzero color at (0, 0). Excluding only that coordinate, collect every other cell of the same color, compute their inclusive bounding box, and return the unchanged input subgrid inside that box. Zeros, foreign colors, and even the marker itself are preserved whenever they lie inside the computed box.
